changelog.name: DiscordAutoTranslate 1.0.1
changelog.body:
# DiscordAutoTranslate 1.0.1

## ✨ 新功能
 - feat: use vector artwork as app icon
 - feat: localize settings by system language
 - feat: translate multilingual Discord messages
 - feat: add configurable streaming requests

## 🐛 修复
 - fix(release): correct changelog range for detached release tags
 - fix: reduce launcher artwork size
 - fix: enlarge transparent launcher artwork
 - fix: use transparent Discord icon artwork
 - fix: use reference artwork for app icon
 - fix: restore config sync generation guard
 - fix: save settings before module activation
 - fix: allow non-view rerender targets
 - fix: emoji 锚点丢失时降级对齐，不再整条拒译

## ⚙️ 改进与优化
 - perf: compress launcher icon asset
 - refactor: enforce single translation paths
 - refactor: 合并 emoji 锚点对齐路径

## 📦 其他
 - chore(release): 3-1.0.1
 - ci: sync stable releases to LSPosed module repo
 - ui: select target language from dropdown
 - test: align strict mapping expectations
 - test: import strict alignment assertion
 - test: 补 assertNull 导入
 - test: 断言保留原文节点前导空格；严格化丢锚点断言
 - test: 修正实例比较 bug（同一节点树引用）
 - test: 复现角色提及+标题+自定义emoji消息保持英文（记录当前行为）

基于 `main` 最新代码构建，versionCode 3。

changelog.name: DiscordAutoTranslate 1.0.0
changelog.body:
Discord 消息自动翻译（英文 → 简体中文）模块 1.0.0 正式版。

- 基于 LibXposed API 102，适用于 LSPosed
- 保留 Markdown 结构翻译、行内三态图标、回复引用/Embed/投票翻译
- 支持 OpenAI-Compatible / OpenAI-Responses / Anthropic Messages 与 SSE
- APK 已签名（证书 CN=DiscordAutoTranslate, O=wxmyyds）

readme:
# Discord AutoTranslate **Discord 多语言消息自动翻译模块 | Multilingual Discord message translation** 基于 [LibXposed API 102](https://github.com/libxposed/api)。 [源码与构建 Source](https://github.com/wxmyyds/DiscordAutoTranslate) · [Releases](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.wxmyyds.discordautotranslate/releases) [简体中文](#简体中文) | [English](#english)
--- ## 简体中文 Discord AutoTranslate 是一个 LSPosed 模块，可将 Discord 消息翻译为设置的目标语言。 ### 功能 - 自动翻译多语言消息，并按原位置替换正文 - 保留 Markdown 标题、列表、提及、表情和代码等结构 - 行内图标显示翻译状态，可切换原文与译文；失败时可重试 - 支持回复引用、编辑后重译、富 Embed 和投票卡片 - 支持 OpenAI-Compatible、OpenAI Responses、Anthropic Messages 协议；部分协议可使用流式响应 - 提供设置页、配置检查、测试连接和测试翻译 ### 系统要求 - Android 8.0 或更新版本（API 26+） - 支持 LibXposed API 102 的 LSPosed - Discord 340.13 Stable（`versionCode` 340013）；其他版本不保证兼容 ### 安装与配置 1. 从本仓库 [Releases](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.wxmyyds.discordautotranslate/releases) 下载并安装 APK。 2. 打开模块设置，填写 API URL、密钥和模型并保存。可以在启用 LSPosed 模块前完成配置。 3. 在 LSPosed 中启用 **Discord AutoTranslate**，并将 `com.discord` 加入作用域。 4. 强制停止并重启 Discord。 模块启用前保存的配置会在 LSPosed service 可用后自动同步。设置页可使用「测试连接」和「测试翻译」检查配置。 ### 隐私 消息正文会发送到你配置的翻译服务；消息正文与译文不会写入模块日志。API 密钥保存在本机私有配置中，并同步至 LSPosed remote preferences。 ### 免责声明 本项目与 Discord Inc. 无关联。Discord 为 Discord Inc. 的商标。使用本模块可能违反 Discord 服务条款，请自行评估风险。 --- ## English Discord AutoTranslate is an LSPosed module that translates Discord messages into your selected target language. ### Features - Automatically translate multilingual messages and replace their text in place - Preserve Markdown structures such as headings, lists, mentions, emoji, and code - Inline status icon with original/translation toggle and retry on failure - Translate reply previews, edited messages, rich embeds, and poll cards - Supports OpenAI-Compatible, OpenAI Responses, and Anthropic Messages APIs; streaming is available for supported protocols - Includes a settings screen, configuration checks, connection testing, and translation testing ### Requirements - Android 8.0 or later (API 26+) - LSPosed with LibXposed API 102 support - Discord 340.13 Stable (`versionCode` 340013); other versions are not guaranteed to work ### Installation and Setup 1. Download and install the APK from this repository's [Releases](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.wxmyyds.discordautotranslate/releases). 2. Open the module settings, enter your API URL, key, and model, then save. You can do this before enabling the LSPosed module. 3. Enable **Discord AutoTranslate** in LSPosed and add `com.discord` to its scope. 4. Force-stop and restart Discord. Settings saved before activation are synchronized automatically when the LSPosed service becomes available. Use **Test Connection** and **Test Translation** in the settings screen to verify your configuration. ### Privacy Message content is sent to your configured translation service. Message content and translations are not written to the module logs. The API key is stored in the app's private storage and synchronized to LSPosed remote preferences. ### Disclaimer This project is not affiliated with Discord Inc. Discord is a trademark of Discord Inc. Use of this module may violate Discord's Terms of Service; use it at your own discretion.
